summary: Iteration 2 verification: 14/14 pytest backend cases pass (clues on all 4 cases, SSE witness stream with 'event: done' terminator, replays CRUD, and verdict regression). Full mobile web flow driven with Playwright at 390x844: brief -> investigate -> proceed with clue IDs in URL -> courtroom -> cross-exam -> FROM INVESTIGATION badge shown -> custom question typed & sent -> streaming witness reply grows in-place -> hammer -> verdict -> VIEW & SHARE REPLAY -> replay detail (share-cta / share-hdr / delete-hdr all present) -> Profile tab -> My Replays -> replays list shows saved rows with replay-{id} testIDs. Backend verdict bug from iteration_1 is fixed.
action_items: None blocking. Optional polish: investigation folders use accordion (single-open) behaviour, so only the most-recently-tapped folder renders its clue-{id} rows even though the discovered counter accumulates correctly — confirm this is intended.

Optional: cross-exam sheet only rendered 4 ask-opt items in the viewport during smoke run (expected 2 unlocked + 5 base = 7). Verify the sheet is scrollable so the full list is reachable on small screens.
critical_code_review_comments: Clue payloads are typed with a Pydantic model (Clue) and seeded on startup — clean.
SSE endpoint yields TextDelta chunks and emits an explicit 'event: done' terminator with X-Accel-Buffering: no; verified end-to-end from public URL.
Replay model uses uuid + isoformat defaults and list_replays sorts by created_at desc — verified with two saved rows.
server.py compute_verdict now correctly reads req.stats.role (previous iteration_1 bug fixed).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_federal_trial.py (expanded to 14 cases covering clues, SSE, replays CRUD, verdict regression)
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted a TEST_replay_user replay inside fixtures. Two 'guest' replays were also generated by the end-to-end Playwright run (from tapping the hammer -> Verdict -> View & Share Replay). Safe to purge from db.replays if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env. Pytest suite `/app/backend/tests/test_federal_trial.py` — run `pytest backend/tests/test_federal_trial.py -v` from /app. Streaming test asserts multiple data: frames plus an `event: done` terminator; ~5-15s response. Frontend flow: deep-linking to `/case/{id}` skips role-select if already chosen and lands on brief-screen. Investigation folders are accordion (single expanded at a time) but counter accumulates. Cross-exam question sheet uses testIDs ask-opt-{i}; custom input is custom-question-input + custom-question-send. Replay list rows use testID replay-{uuid}; replay detail exposes replay-share, replay-delete, replay-share-cta.
rca_of_issue: N/A — iteration_1 verdict bug is fixed and all new-feature tests are green.
